items.title: Bernstein lifts TKO target in early 2027 preview
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bernstein lifted its price target on TKO Group, the owner of UFC and WWE, to $240 from $235 in a note Wednesday, publishing what it called a "way-too-early" preview of 2027.

items.title: TKO Group Holdings Inc's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: TKO Group Holdings Inc (NYSE:TKO) recently announced a total dividend of $0.79 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-15.  This amount consists entirely of a $0.79 per share cash dividend, payable on 2026-09-30.  For investors, the ex-dividend date is a critical marker: shareholders must own the stock before this date to qualify for the payment.
